description.default: 🔓 Open source · Finally finish what you read — and what you write: progressive reading digests long-form input day by day (excerpts, slicing, cloze, flashcards, AI knowledge maps), progressive writing queues your material into finished drafts (writing books, structure tree, compile-to-draft). A full loop from reading to writing.
description.zh_CN: 🔓 已开源 · 让长文读得完，让作品写得完：渐进阅读消化输入（摘抄、分片、挖空、闪卡、AI 知识地图），渐进写作排队产出（写作书素材入槽、结构树看进度、汇编成稿）——从阅读到写作的完整闭环
